character.label: 职业原型人物（演示形体，不是剧中角色）
character.prefix: Original fantasy concept art for a live-action film costume department. One adult character archetype shown full body, head to toe fully visible with generous empty margin above the head and below the feet, standing in a natural three-quarter front pose. Plain warm light-grey studio backdrop with soft floor shadow, no scenery. Photorealistic cinematic look, practical costume materials (worn leather, wool, linen, forged metal), believable human proportions. Unless the description says otherwise, the person has ordinary human anatomy with round human ears and no scars.
character.suffix: A fresh original design not based on any existing game, film or book character or faction. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no split panels. No real-world religious, royal, national or occult symbols: no crosses or inverted crosses, no pentagrams or five-pointed stars, no triple-moon signs, no fleur-de-lis, no triangle-circle-line sigils, no swastika-like or real runic letters.

race.prefix: Original fantasy species design sheet for a live-action film. Plain warm light-grey studio backdrop with soft floor shadow. Photorealistic cinematic look with practical prosthetic-makeup realism; anatomy features clearly readable.
race.suffix: Original design that must not resemble any existing game, film or book species design. No text, no letters, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no split panels.
